responsibility: Declares the gm2 quadruple-to-GCC-tree translation layer. Its API covers conversion of quad ranges into GCC trees, quad-based constant-expression resolution callbacks, helper routines for unbounded-array high bounds, string-to-char coercion, generic pointer formation from lvalues, typed zero-constant adjustment, and string-copy preparation, distinguishing it from the separate declaration stage in `M2GCCDeclare`.
same_name_distinction: Definition module for the M2GenGCC pair: it only publishes the quad-to-GCC-tree conversion API and helper entry points, while `gcc/m2/gm2-compiler/M2GenGCC.mod` contains the actual lowering logic, tree construction, constant folding, and source-location-aware diagnostics.
